description: Ethernet/Wi-Fi OEE data logger with six digital and two analog inputs: counters, input levels, analog values, network and MQTT status, circular memory and configuration
source: Novus DigiRail OEE, Modbus-TCP protocol manual (Portuguese)

sources.title: DigiRail OEE – Protocolo Modbus-TCP
sources.note: linked in issue #436; status, configuration and circular-memory register tables

notes: Modbus TCP, up to 3 clients at once. The device answers on its configured Modbus address; requests for other addresses are forwarded to the RS485 port (TCP/RTU gateway).
Functions 0x03 (up to 125 registers), 0x06 and 0x10. Every register is a holding register; the addresses are the ones in the manual's Endereço column.
32-bit values are two registers, high word first. The analog values in mA or V and in the user range are 32-bit floats.
Text settings hold two characters per register.
Circular memory: read registers 187 to 189 to find the stored records, write the position wanted (from 1) to register 190, then read registers 191 to 211. A position with no record reads 0xFFFF.
Reserved rows of the manual are left out.
Written from the manufacturer's manual; not tested on a device.
